justification: Standard: changes six production writers so reviewed never-serve rules are skipped, adds a live DQ probe; production rows were changed separately with user approval and backups. Not Critical: no schema change, skips only listed ids.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions: 97 Canterbury-Bankstown chapter 2.2 rows (ids in data/chapter_scope/never_serve.json); now current, v2_is_actionable FALSE, precinct layer, no key.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Hiding a rule by removing its precinct key was assumed permanent; derive_precinct_keys re-keys by page range after every publish and does not know which rows were hidden on purpose.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New list data/chapter_scope/never_serve.json; not may-apply-areas.json or not_covered, because those also name rows that are keyed and served on purpose.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_never_serve.py -q -o addopts= ; python scripts/dq_probe_live.py --id DQ-148
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The skip is removed from derive_precinct_keys, gate_rules or enrichment, the loader count check is removed, or Dockerfile.monitors stops copying scripts/never_serve.py.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Five break-checks each turned the tests red (derive, gate, enrichment, loader, Dockerfile copy) and green when restored. DQ-148 reads 0 live after the production fix.

functions.name: never_serve.ids
functions.output: the frozen set of listed row ids
functions.if_none: a missing or miscounted list raises instead of returning an empty set

functions.name: derive_precinct_keys.run
functions.input: council, apply flag and rule filter from the command line or a publish
functions.output: precinct keys written for derived rows, listed rows skipped and counted
functions.if_none: rows with no derivation are counted as before

functions.name: gate_rules.apply_gate_rules
functions.input: database cursor, council and the gate rule list
functions.output: layer and condition updates, listed rows skipped
functions.if_none: no matching rows means no updates

queries.purpose: DQ-148: listed rows out of their safe state plus switched-on text copies
queries.where_clause: id = ANY(listed) AND is_current AND v2_is_actionable = FALSE AND precinct AND key NULL; plus same council/chapter and text fingerprint

break_it.what_happens: Before: the 97 rows were re-keyed and served to all of former Bankstown.
Before: it could switch them back on.

break_it.scenario: The chapter is re-read and the rows get new ids.
break_it.what_happens: An id-only guard would read 0 while new copies leak.
break_it.how: DQ-148 counts listed ids no longer current and text copies switched on

break_it.scenario: The job image lacks the helper.
break_it.what_happens: Every re-derive after publish would fail for every council.
break_it.repro: remove the COPY line: 4 tests fail

post_merge.manual_verify: Railway monitors image rebuild picks up scripts/never_serve.py; next C-B publish log should show never-serve-skipped=97.
